task.title: Update a Kubernetes Deployment using a rolling update
task.shortdesc: Change the container image for a Deployment and monitor the rolling update until completion.

step.cmd: Review current image and revision: kubectl describe deploy <app> -n <ns> | grep -E 'Image|Revision'.
Set the new image: kubectl set image deploy/<app> <containerName>=<newImage>:<tag> -n <ns>.
Monitor the rolling update: kubectl rollout status deploy/<app> -n <ns>.
Validate new Pods are running the new image: kubectl get pods -n <ns> -l app=<app> -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'.
If needed, undo the change: kubectl rollout undo deploy/<app> -n <ns>.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
